description: This file defines the internal implementation of gRPC status errors, including the Status struct, methods for creating, manipulating, and retrieving details from status objects, and error handling mechanisms. It is part of the gRPC internal error handling package.

classes.name: Status
classes.description: Represents an RPC status with code, message, and details. Immutable and created via constructors.

classes.name: Error
classes.description: Wraps a Status for error handling, implements error interface, and provides methods for error comparison and retrieval.

methods.name: NewWithProto
methods.description: Creates a new Status from a code, message, and optional status proto string, used mainly by gRPC library.

methods.name: New
methods.description: Creates a new Status with specified code and message.

methods.name: Newf
methods.description: Creates a new Status with formatted message.

methods.name: FromProto
methods.description: Creates a Status from an existing proto.Status message.

methods.name: Err
methods.description: Returns an error from a code and message, or nil if code is OK.

methods.name: Errorf
methods.description: Returns an error with formatted message.

methods.name: Proto
methods.description: Returns the status as a proto.Status message.

methods.name: Err
methods.description: Returns an error object representing the status, or nil if status code is OK.

methods.name: WithDetails
methods.description: Returns a new Status with additional detail messages attached.

methods.name: Details
methods.description: Returns attached detail messages, decoding errors are included as errors.

methods.name: String
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the error.

methods.name: GRPCStatus
methods.description: Returns the Status object associated with the error.

methods.name: IsRestrictedControlPlaneCode
methods.description: Checks if the status code is restricted for control plane usage.

methods.name: RawStatusProto
methods.description: Returns the internal protobuf message for gRPC use.
